proposals.title: Climate Change 2022: Mitigation of Climate Change – Chapter 12: Cross-sectoral Perspectives (Carbon Dioxide Removal)
proposals.container: IPCC Sixth Assessment Report, Working Group III
proposals.why: Authoritative IPCC AR6 chapter establishing CDR as unavoidable for net-zero CO2 and GHG emissions globally.

proposals.title: Climate Change 2023: Synthesis Report
proposals.why: Integrates AR6 findings; confirms CDR necessary for net-negative CO2 and stabilising temperature.

proposals.title: The State of Carbon Dioxide Removal – 2nd Edition
proposals.why: Global independent scientific assessment of CDR status, gap to Paris goals, and scaling needs.

proposals.title: The carbon dioxide removal gap
proposals.why: Quantifies the gap between national CDR plans and levels needed to limit warming to 1.5 °C.

proposals.title: Evaluating the near- and long-term role of carbon dioxide removal in meeting global climate objectives
proposals.why: Shows land CDR's near-term role and novel CDR scaling to multi-GtCO2 by 2050 and beyond.

proposals.title: Emissions Gap Report 2024: No more hot air … please!
proposals.why: Annual UNEP assessment tracking emissions and removal ambition gaps relative to Paris Agreement targets.

proposals.title: Governance of carbon dioxide removal: an AI-enhanced systematic map of the scientific literature
proposals.why: Systematic map of 876 CDR governance/policy documents; identifies research gaps and coverage patterns.

proposals.title: The State of Carbon Dioxide Removal – 1st Edition
proposals.why: First comprehensive global CDR assessment; introduced the CDR gap concept and baseline data.
